---
title: "AuroraFlow CI analysis"
---

```{julia}
#| output: false
include("results.jl")
include("plots.jl")
result = load_results(ENV["AURORA_RESULTS_FILE"])
mkpath("data")
for (name, data) in [("benchmarks", result.benchmarks), ("resources", result.resources), ("sources", result.sources)]
    CSV.write("data/$name.csv", data)
end
```

[Pipeline {{< env CI_PIPELINE_ID history >}}]({{< env CI_PIPELINE_URL https://git.uni-paderborn.de/pc2-ci/fpga/AuroraFlow/-/pipelines >}})

## Latency and throughput

```{julia}
#| fig-alt: "Latency and throughput over message size."
if !isempty(result.benchmarks)
    for data in groupby(result.benchmarks, :variant, sort=true)
        display(plot_latencies(data))
        display(plot_throughput(data))
    end
end
```

## AuroraFlow core utilization

```{julia}
#| fig-alt: "AuroraFlow core utilization."
if !isempty(result.resources)
    for data in groupby(result.resources, :variant, sort=true)
        display(plot_resources(data))
    end
end
```
